clues.text: Jesus said that if new drink is poured into an old one, it bursts and both are ruined.
The Gibeonites fooled Joshua by loading their donkeys with old ones, cracked and mended.
When Hannah brought young Samuel to the house of the LORD at Shiloh, she took a bull, flour, and one of these.
Young Elihu told Job his belly was so full of words it might burst like a new one.
A psalmist felt like one dried up by smoke, yet he did not forget God's statutes.
God had Jeremiah tell Judah every one of these would be filled, and the people said they already knew that.
Habakkuk warned of woe to anyone who pours from one to make his neighbors drunk and see their nakedness.
